tabs_context_mcp: Lists the tabs of the agent's folder (its tab group), and can create the folder with an empty tab when it does not exist yet.
tabs_create_mcp: Opens a new empty tab in the agent's folder, in the background, optionally in a Private Space of the agent's own that shares no cookies or sign-ins with its other tabs.
tabs_close_mcp: Closes one of the agent's tabs.
navigate: Loads a URL in a tab, or goes back, forward or reloads, then waits for redirects and for the page to settle before giving its final URL and title.
read_page: Returns the page's accessibility tree, each element with a ref the other tools accept, optionally limited to interactive elements or one subtree.
find: Finds up to 20 shown elements whose role, name or text contains a query, ignoring case.
wait_for: Waits until a text, element or role shows or disappears, a control becomes enabled, or the tab reaches a URL, for up to 50 seconds.
get_page_text: Extracts the visible text of the page, its article or main content first.
form_input: Sets the value of an input, text area, select, checkbox or editable element by its ref, and reports what the element holds afterwards.
javascript_tool: Runs JavaScript in the page and returns the value of its last expression; top-level await works.
fetch: Sends an HTTP request from a tab as its page would, with its origin and cookies; a request other than GET or HEAD in one of your profiles waits for your approval.
computer: Clicks, types, presses keys, scrolls, drags and hovers in a tab, takes screenshots, and screenshots one region at full detail; a click or Enter on a control whose label contains a word such as send, pay, order, delete or publish waits for your approval.
resize_window: Sets the size of a tab's viewport to test a layout at another width, without resizing Lilo's window.
read_console_messages: Returns the console output of the tab's current page, optionally only errors or messages containing a text.
read_network_requests: Lists the tab's network requests with their method, status, URL, type, size and duration; once a devtools tool has run on the tab, one request can be read in full, body included.
file_upload: Chooses files for a file input without showing a file panel, once you allow each file.
upload_image: Drops an image on an element or sets it on a file input, from a screenshot the agent took or from a file you allow.
gif_creator: Records the actions in a tab and exports them as an animated GIF to the Downloads folder.
browser_batch: Runs several tool calls in order in one round trip, stopping at the first error.
run: Runs a JavaScript program that calls the other tools itself, for loops and branches over many steps in one round trip, with at most 200 tool calls.
list_profiles: Lists Lilo's profiles, marking the one the agent's tabs use (the Agents profile by default) and the one you work in.
switch_profile: Moves the agent's tabs to another profile so it can act with that profile's sign-ins, once you allow that profile.
reset_profile: Wipes the Agents profile's cookies, storage, cache and history and reloads the agent's tabs; it never touches your own profiles.
list_connected_browsers: Lists the browsers this server can drive, which is only the running Lilo.
select_browser: Selects the browser to drive; Lilo is the only one.
switch_browser: Connects to a browser; Lilo is already connected.
devtools_command: Sends a command of WebKit's Web Inspector protocol to a tab and returns its result, or lists every command this WebKit supports.
devtools_events: Reads the Web Inspector protocol events of a tab, from the domains the agent sent commands to.
network_mock: Intercepts a tab's requests whose URL matches a regular expression to mock, fail, rewrite or delay them.
network_response: Returns a tab's requests in full, with headers, bodies, timings and sizes, or saves them as a HAR file.
cookies: Reads and changes the cookies of a tab's profile, HttpOnly ones included; reading and deleting reach only the cookies of the sites the agent's tabs show.
emulate: Makes a tab look like another environment: user agent, pixel ratio, color scheme, reduced motion, contrast, media type, JavaScript, images, cache, extra headers, a script run before each page, text replacement and freezing.
performance: Measures a tab: load and paint metrics and memory, a timeline profile with a summary, heap snapshots and garbage collection.
